verdict.rationale: Granola documents concrete retention/deletion controls: automatic transcript deletion after a set period, opt-out of model training, and CSV export explicitly framed for GDPR data portability requests. However, the auto-deletion applies only to transcripts, not notes, and there's no documented mechanism for users to delete notes/workspace data outright or a broader data-deletion/right-to-erasure workflow. Missing for 10: explicit note/workspace deletion controls beyond transcripts, a documented full account/data deletion process, and independent corroboration of these privacy controls working as described.
